description: Hand rows to Sorzio. Either pass columns plus up to 500 rows inline (add more with add_rows, 5,000 inline in total), pass upload to get a URL you PUT a CSV to (header row first, up to 25,000 rows, 20 MB), or pass google_sheet_url to import rows directly from a connected or link-shared Google Sheet into a Hosted List. Hosted lists stay for 2 hours on Free, 7 days on Pro, and forever on Scale after the last run finishes. Keep each call under about 4 MB; use an upload for more. Free.

columns.description: Column names, in order. Required for inline rows.

google_sheet_url.description: Import rows directly from a docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/... URL (connected or link-shared) into a Hosted List.

rows.description: Up to 500 rows; one value per column, in column order.

upload.description: Ask for a CSV upload URL instead of inline rows.

name: create_list
title: Create a list
